evidence.excerpt: Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks.

evidence.excerpt: Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike.
